description: In a science fair, there are two types of tables that can be used to display the children’s science experiments. At the circular tables, 4 poster boards and 5 participants can fit around the table to cater to 8 guests. At the rectangular tables, 4 poster boards and 4 participants can fit around the table to cater to 12 guests. However, each circular table takes up 15 units of space while each rectangular table takes up 20 units of space. The science fair has must be able to fit at least 500 participants and 300 poster boards. If the science fair has available 1900 units of space, how many of each type of table should be set up to maximize the number of catered guests?

PosterBoardsPerCircularTable.definition: Number of poster boards per circular table

ParticipantsPerCircularTable.definition: Number of participants per circular table

GuestsPerCircularTable.definition: Number of guests catered per circular table

SpacePerCircularTable.definition: Space units taken by one circular table

PosterBoardsPerRectangularTable.definition: Number of poster boards per rectangular table

ParticipantsPerRectangularTable.definition: Number of participants per rectangular table

GuestsPerRectangularTable.definition: Number of guests catered per rectangular table

SpacePerRectangularTable.definition: Space units taken by one rectangular table

MinimumParticipants.definition: Minimum number of participants to be accommodated

MinimumPosterBoards.definition: Minimum number of poster boards to be accommodated

objective.description: "Maximize the total number of guests catered by selecting the optimal number of circular and rectangular tables"

constraints.description: 5 * (number of circular tables) + 4 * (number of rectangular tables) >= MinimumParticipants
15 * (number of circular tables) + 20 * (number of rectangular tables) <= AvailableSpace
Number of circular tables and number of rectangular tables must be integers

CircularTables.definition: Number of circular tables to be set up

RectangularTables.definition: Number of rectangular tables to be set up
